_about: Super vs Ultra on the same 10 labelled DPAs (objection-window terms, 5 scored fields, verbatim quote gate), 3 readings each, the same prompt. Recompute: owin eval score --brief (Super, headline runs) and owin eval score --brief --file eval/runs/20261028T233749-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b.json (Ultra). Ultra run on 2026-10-28 23:37 EDT, 30 calls; the earlier spike (2026-10-21, not recorded in this repository) had both at 8/10 with an older prompt.
reading: Equal accuracy on this set (10/10 both, 30/30 readings both); Ultra costs about 3.9x per reading, so three Super readings cost less than one Ultra reading. This set is small and saturated; it supports the price choice, not a general accuracy ranking.
